title: Water Bill Tracking Monthly Cost Trend
dataSources: Utility bills (`utility:bill`), utility meter readings (`utility:meter`), utility rate changes (`utility:rate`), household accounts (`household:account`), utility payments (`utility:payment`).
app: Electric, gas, and water bills, smart-meter readings, household-account records, and utility rate-plan changes streamed to Splunk HEC via portals, CSV exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utility:bill bill_type="water"
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(bill_amount) as total_cost avg(usage_gallons) as avg_usage by _time
| sort - _time
description: Trends monthly cost and average usage behind water bill tracking so household utility drift is easy to spot.
value: Monthly utility views catch slow bill creep that is hard to see when statements arrive one at a time.
implementation: Normalize units per commodity during ingest so monthly usage stays comparable.
visualization: Dual-axis chart of monthly total cost and average usage.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how the cost behind water bill tracking changes over time.
